summary: Both T040-recorded defects are fixed, verified end-to-end by this attempt, and the fresh full compile census is recorded: 2116/2116 identities ELF artifacts, 0 refusals, 0 crashes. Provenance: the primary implementation arrived on the tree from the terminated WTI044 child (engine-committed as 49c1837: a100c/frontend/gridmodel.py identity-stable grid folding, tools/run_scan.py comma-safe evidence paths, a100c/tests/test_t041_repairs.py regression, test_compile_sweep.py --merge chunked-census machinery); nothing from that dead child had been verified, so this attempt re-verified everything through its own executions and completed the missing census. (1) GRID BAKING: verified fixed -- both gdn2 shapes ([17] and [3,17,2,7] float32, one identity) now extract the IDENTICAL grid model (axis0 cdiv(bundle_scalar T,16), axis1 bundle_view(Akkd,0)*bundle_view(Akkd,2) -- all runtime reads, no literal axis); compiled in separate fresh processes both shapes share cache key 25378fd62178 with BYTE-IDENTICAL executables (pre-fix: same key 020c5b09, different executables 44bfa945/48929706); [3,17,2,7] compares PASS under both compile orders (max_err 3.2e-8) and [17] passes on the cold-order cache; the bake-probe control refuses located for both shapes and the stability-rule-disabled control reproduces the pre-fix fold to 2 (load-bearing). The 24 mixed-arity-SHAPES corpus operators were probed: all 135 cases extract a model, 0 refusals. (2) COMMA PATH: verified fixed -- evidence dir names are comma-free and injective, the QEMU -plugin arg carries no comma, a real QEMU roundtrip writes counts.json at the sanitized path while the unsanitized comma path is NOT created (negative control), and the chunk_abc [2,2,17,9,8,4]#float16 resource-flagged case through tools/run_scan.py itself: no LAUNCH_FAIL, executed, compared PASS, evidence (instruction counts, 4 active workers on 4 distinct units, binding, listing) recorded at the comma-free path; its final row status is EVIDENCE_FAIL only on the pre-existing IME witness condition (this case's dot is the fp32 reshape form, no IME family applies; even the perf representative carries only smt.vfwmadot), asserted recorded honestly, never fabricated. (3) CENSUS: taken cold and chunked (19 operator-disjoint restricted sweeps over isolated cache roots + --merge, all checks PASS): 500 operators, 2734 cases, 2116 identities -> 2116 riscv64-ELF artifacts, 0 refusals, 0 over-budget, 0 crashes, 618 repeat-case reuse checks 0 violations, 2114 compiles = 2113 distinct artifact keys + 1 layout split (within the 1.25x2161 economics), all six basic passes enabled with rewrites fired (cse 76888, licm 17602, constprop 7444, strength_reduction 6776, dce 7327, copyprop 261). Census repairs this attempt made to complete it honestly: (a) test_compile_sweep.py compile-economics now counts compilation units as DISTINCT ARTIFACT KEYS (+ layout splits) instead of corpus identities -- several corpus identities legitimately share one artifact key when the specialization is coarser than the corpus meta tier (var_mean_welford [17]/[97]: N is a runtime scalar, the shared artifact reads it from the bundle -- no baking; the T029 census already recorded this pairing; the phenomenon is now recorded in the census as artifact_key_sharing: 3 identities sharing a key); (b) the parallel-chunk first wave hit a real concurrency defect in MY chunk design, not the compiler: two chunks sharing one cache root race on a100c/runtime/build.py's non-atomic object-cache writes (one amp_update_scale link crash, RuntimeError gcc exit 1; the same case compiles cleanly in isolation, sha e5727b84f4d6) -- the affected chunks were re-run on isolated roots, all green. Full a100c test suite: 46 pass, 0 fail (every test file except the full-corpus sweep, including the new test_t041_repairs.py).

evidence: docs/compiler-agent/COMPILE_CENSUS.json (the fresh full cold census: 2116 identities / 2116 ELF artifacts / 0 refusals / 0 crashes, chunked:true with all 19 chunk commands and summaries) plus docs/compiler-agent/COMPILE_CENSUS.t041-evidence.json (the raw execution logs of every verification command). The load-bearing controls: (1) the pre-fix reproduction recorded by T040 (same cache key 020c5b09 for both gdn2 shapes but different executables) is replaced by one shared key 25378fd62178 with byte-identical executables, and the [3,17,2,7] case that previously mismatched (Akk 0.0 vs 1.0) now compares PASS under both compile orders; (2) the bake-probe control test refuses located while disabling the stability rule reproduces the silent fold -- the refusal is not vacuous; (3) the QEMU comma roundtrip's negative control (the unsanitized path is NOT created) proves the pre-fix split; (4) the chunk_abc resource case that previously recorded LAUNCH_FAIL now executes, compares PASS and records its evidence; (5) the census's 618 repeat-case cache-hit checks and the 3 shared-key identities (var_mean_welford) are exactly the no-baking contract: the shared artifact reads the differing runtime values from the bundle.
remaining_work: a100c/runtime/build.py writes its content-addressed object cache non-atomically (if not obj.is_file(): gcc -o obj): two compile processes sharing one cache root race on the same .o and one link can fail (observed once as the amp_update_scale chunk crash; the case compiles cleanly in isolation). Single-process sweeps -- the declared sweep form -- are unaffected. A follow-up should write to a temp path and os.replace, making the object cache concurrent-safe.

deconv3d_fwd_kernel produced its first-ever artifacts this census (refused in every prior census) at ~500s per identity -- now the corpus's heaviest compile. A correctness-neutral compile-cost finding for any future performance round; the per-identity budget (600s) currently covers it with little margin.

The dev-lane resource-evidence representative (chunk_abc fp16) cannot satisfy its declared IME instruction witnesses: the case's source-level dot is the fp32 reshape form (K < 16, no IME family applies) and even the perf representative carries only smt.vfwmadot, so the row honestly records EVIDENCE_FAIL. The representative-selection rule or the per-case witness set needs a manager decision so an IME-applicable case carries the IME evidence contract.

The full executed-and-compared regression over the corpus at this revision (execution and comparison of every case, multi-worker and resource evidence) is the next phase's scan work; this task's census establishes that every identity compiles to an ELF artifact with zero refusals.
